gloss: to exterminate; to slay; to get rid of

definitions.gloss: to exterminate; to slay; to get rid of
definitions.explanation: To defeat and eliminate monsters, pests, villains, or other undesirable things. Used both in folklore and legends (slaying demons) and in everyday life (getting rid of pests).

examples.japanese: ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{退治|たいじ}する。
⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゴキブリ→ゴキブリ：05131_gokiburi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{退治|たいじ}した。
examples.english: I got rid of the cockroach in the kitchen.
Momotaro took a dog, a monkey, and a pheasant with him and went to Onigashima to slay the demons.

notes:
A word deeply rooted in Japanese folklore, where heroes slay monsters and demons. In everyday use, commonly applied to getting rid of household pests. Has a somewhat dramatic or heroic tone even in mundane contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧: demon slaying
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧: pest extermination
- ⟦ゴキブリ→ゴキブリ：05131_gokiburi⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧: cockroach extermination
- ⟦{悪者|わるもの}→悪者：29398_warumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{退治|たいじ}する: to defeat the villain

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many famous Japanese folktales center on ⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧: {桃太郎|ももたろう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧ (Momotaro's demon slaying), {大江山|おおえやま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒呑童子|しゅてんどうじ}⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧ (slaying Shuten-doji), and ⟦{蜘蛛|くも}→蜘蛛：02203_kumo⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧ (spider slaying) are among the most well-known.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駆除|くじょ}する→駆除する：21319_kujosuru⟧: to exterminate (pests) — more technical and practical, used by pest control professionals, while ⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧ has a more narrative or dramatic quality
- ⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to defeat — broader meaning of defeating an opponent, without the specific "eliminate the threat" nuance of ⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧
